updates.датасет: Adult FlyWire central-brain connectome, public materialization v.630, with 127,400 proofread neurons included in the leaky integrate-and-fire model; the article describes over 125,000 neurons and 50 million synaptic connections in the broader connectome.

validation.notes: Primary Nature/PMC full JATS checked again on 2026-09-28. Methods > Computational model explicitly pins this study's model graph to FlyWire materialization v.630 and 127,400 proofread neurons. Optogenetic and behavioral tests validate scoped feeding/grooming predictions in flies, not a held-out human cohort. This S775 release does not identify upstream releases of the separate S740 VNC simulation matrices.
